evidence: We have characterized the (GaAs) (GaP) LD±SPSL and the (GaAs) (GaAs P ) MQWR by transmission electron microscopy (TEM), photoluminescencem 0.8 0.2 n (PL) and PL excitation (PLE) measurements. PL and PLE measurements were performed at 20 K by using a laser-diode pumped Nd:YAG laser with a frequency doubler (532 nm), and a Ti:sapphire laser pumped by an Ar ion laser.
